title: Citizenship and Immigration
description: Understanding citizenship acquisition, rights, and immigration policies in Nepal.

sections.title: Categories of Citizenship
sections.content: Citizenship may be acquired by descent, birth under defined criteria, naturalization, or honorary grant. Each pathway carries specific eligibility requirements.

sections.title: Rights and Obligations
sections.content: Citizens enjoy fundamental rights, political participation, and access to public services while bearing obligations such as loyalty to the state and tax compliance.

sections.title: Immigration Policy Framework
sections.content: Immigration regulations govern entry, residence, work authorization, and deportation procedures, balancing economic needs with security and social cohesion.

sections.title: Emerging Issues and Debates
sections.content: Debates focus on diaspora engagement, statelessness risks, gender equality in transmission, and modernization of identity systems.

sections.title: Historical Evolution
sections.content: Citizenship and immigration frameworks shifted alongside political transitions, refining eligibility clarity, gender equity, and procedural safeguards.

sections.title: Diaspora Engagement Strategies
sections.content: Policy focus on investment facilitation, knowledge exchange, and cultural linkage programs encourages diaspora contributions while maintaining regulatory compliance.

sections.title: Statelessness Mitigation
sections.content: Targeted documentation drives, birth registration expansion, and gender‑neutral transmission policies reduce statelessness risk among vulnerable populations.

sections.title: Case Study: Digital Identity Rollout
sections.content: Pilot digital ID linking civil registry and immigration records improved verification speed and reduced duplicate applications while raising data privacy considerations.

sections.title: Future Outlook
sections.content: Integrated digital identity ecosystems, streamlined risk‑based visa processes, diaspora innovation platforms, and robust privacy safeguards will shape modernization.

summary: Multiple acquisition pathways with clarified eligibility
Rights balanced by civic and tax obligations
Historical evolution improved gender equity & safeguards
Statelessness mitigation hinges on documentation & registration
Digital ID pilots enhance integrity but raise privacy needs
Policy debates steer modernization & inclusion aims
Future: integrated IDs, risk-based processing, privacy frameworks
